headline: Bruins get steamrolled in St. Louis and need a serious reset
morning_brew: I watched the Bruins get pushed around in St. Louis on Thursday night and I've got to say, that performance was absolutely disgusting. Giving up four goals to the Blues while only managing to light the lamp once is not how we play hockey in Boston. Jeremy Swayman didn't have his usual magic, finishing with a save percentage under eight hundred, and the whole team looked like they were skating in mud the second the second period started.

It is a short turnaround for the boys now, with the Blackhawks coming into the Garden on Saturday afternoon for a matinee. We have no time to mope around after that loss in Missouri, not when we've got points to chase in the Atlantic. I need to see some real life from the top line and a lot more urgency on the defensive end. If we keep playing like we did on Thursday, my neighbor Rick is going to start writing his manifestos about the state of the franchise, and nobody needs that kind of negativity in their life.

Looking ahead to tonight, the C's are back at the Garden for an NBA Cup opener against the Bulls. It's a Friday night in the Hub and the Celtics have a chance to set the tone early in this tournament. I'll be glued to the screen expecting a dominant showing, because frankly, after the way the B's looked on the road, I need a win to remind me what a professional basketball team actually looks like.

news_digest.headline: Bruins try to extend home win streak, face the Blackhawks
news_digest.dans_take: Saturday at home is the perfect time to burn the tape from that disaster in St. Louis and get back to business.

trend_watch.dans_take: He's usually our safety net, but that performance was like trying to catch a puck with a screen door.
